The '''Quellor Run''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] section of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It took its name from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Quellor/Legends|Quellor]], which was located along the route.
